comparison.objective: Select and orient a dielectric union and copper coupling for two material-specific pipe gaps.
comparison.physical_skill: Part selection, orientation, seating, and release without disturbing the pipe run.
comparison.success_condition: Union is correctly oriented in the steel-to-copper gap, copper coupling fills the copper gap, both are released, and wrong fittings or disturbed pipes fail.
comparison.reason: Tests semantic fitting selection and connector seating; it lacks controlled impact, notch fracture, and recovery of released debris.
